parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.command: set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members 5
set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN成员。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.command: set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode trunk
set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换模式为trunk。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching storm-control [parameter3]
set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.command: set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching storm-control default
set interfaces ae1 unit 0 family etherne.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换风暴控制为默认设置。
